reference_sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start,
  ROUND(SUM(-e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit), 2) AS churned_mrr
FROM subscription_events e
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
WHERE e.event_type = 'churn'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE)

WITH churned AS (
  -- one row per churn event, in euros
  SELECT e.event_date, -e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS lost_eur
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_type = 'churn'
    AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, ROUND(SUM(lost_eur), 2) AS churned_mrr
FROM churned
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE)

solver.query:
WITH ev AS (SELECT e.account_id, a.segment, e.event_type, e.event_date, s.currency, e.mrr_delta_local AS d, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS eur
  FROM subscription_events e JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31') SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, ROUND(-SUM(eur), 2) AS churned_mrr FROM ev WHERE event_type = 'churn' AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1
